(2) The camera focuses on the older man as he explains a concept; he has purple glasses resting on his forehead and wears a white patterned shirt under a light jacket. He gestures with his hands while holding a yellow microphone. (3) Reactions shots show the interviewers displaying high-arousal facial expressions, including wide eyes and open mouths in shock. His voice is deep, calm, and exhibits a 'Professional/Narrative' tone, contrasting with the chaotic energy of the interviewers. The interviewers are heard laughing with high valence, their voices overlapping as they react to the interviewee's story about winning the lottery.
